attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Beyond routine dependency bumps, this PR reworks shortcode name validation to use full parsing (Shortcode Parser) instead of simple identifier scanning, and removes/alters FluidValue GetValue/GetIndex overrides on HtmlContentValue and StringValuesValue tied to the Fluid 2.31 upgrade, which could subtly change Liquid template behavior (property/index access, nil vs empty results) across many tenants' templates."}
